assessment_scope: M4 first-pass exact snapshot identity finding; full milestone tests, source maintenance and final frozen assessment remain pending.

findings.evidence: Major: snapshot_report and child classifier/record validator inherit ordinary Git object substitution. Owned real-Git repro replaces malformed-store child commit with clean empty-store ancestor; same requested immutable SHA changes failure to passed/validated0 without changing requested identity.
findings.required_outcome: Bind all snapshot enumeration/classification/blob reads to literal requested Git objects, consistently disabling replace refs through wrapper and child validators. Reject/neutralize ambient Git repository redirection and prevent automatic lazy network fetch or trace side effects where they defeat exact-root/read-only proof. Add actual Git replacement/ambient-env regression with unchanged repository and malformed snapshot still failing, retain clean snapshot versus dirty-worktree distinction, and rerun affected boundary/selector tests before independent reassessment.

independence_basis: Separate nonauthor reviewer inspected M4 snapshot path and reproduced replacement-ref bypass in an invocation-owned real Git repository; no reviewed implementation authored.
limitations: No final M4 approval or full validation result claimed; selector suite still being reconciled.
rationale: Public snapshot wrapper promises immutable commit validation but all Git reads honor replacement refs. Exact SHA syntax and rev-parse equality do not bind the actual tree/blob bytes under Git replacement.

Actual Git reproduction: clean commit with no stores; child commit with malformed docs/changes/bad/change.json. Validation of badSHA fails initially, then git replace badSHA cleanSHA makes the identical badSHA return passed with validated0 and original badSHA reported.

Current replacement proof must preserve unknown/malformed current record detection and read-only exact-source identity; deleted historical Git-hardening tests do not authorize this current bypass. Release checklist AST transfer inspected separately and retained functions are unchanged.
summary: Exact-revision current-record validation can report success for different Git replacement content.
